title: Exercise for Depression - Cochrane Systematic Review
citation: Cooney GM, Dwan K, Greig CA, et al. Exercise for depression. Cochrane Database Syst Rev. 2013;(9):CD004366. doi:10.1002/14651858.CD004366.pub6
description: Gold standard dataset for validation testing. Meta-analysis comparing exercise vs control for depression outcomes (continuous: depression scores).

expected_results.method_details: Standardized mean difference calculated using pre-computed effect sizes. Negative values favor exercise intervention.

interpretation: Exercise showed a moderate effect in reducing depression scores compared to control conditions (SMD = -0.51, 95% CI: -0.69 to -0.33, p < 0.001). Low heterogeneity (I² = 0%) indicates consistent effects across studies.
validation_notes: This dataset is used to validate our meta-analysis calculations against published Cochrane review results. Target accuracy: pooled effect within ±5%, heterogeneity statistics within ±10%.
